name: phygital-engram
description: Your notes, found in milliseconds. Phygital Engram is a fast, private, read-only search for your second brain, or any folder of Markdown notes, for your AI agent.

notes_folder.title: Your notes folder
notes_folder.description: The folder of Markdown notes to search. Phygital Engram only reads it, and it needs a file named CLAUDE.md at the top (it can be empty).

data_folder.title: Folder for the index
data_folder.description: Where Phygital Engram keeps its own files. It must be outside your notes folder. You can delete it at any time.
